b4_evidence_expiry.age: pre-update seconds; empty without reliable history

missing: empty = not measured/not applicable; -1 in timing = not executed

rows.FRAME: one per image; frame counters and times only
rows.INSTANCE: one per B4 track; TTL-lost has NOT_VISIBLE and no stale B2/B3 metrics
rows.FEATURE_GROUP: disjoint main Frame feature groups, feature_count sums to N

allow: policy proposal, NOT proof of application; coarse uses previous state, fine/map current state
actions: DISABLED, PROPOSE_PASS/REJECT/DENY, PASS/REJECT/DENY, NOT_RUN, RESTORED_FALLBACK; map is indexed feature eligibility, not a promise to insert a KeyFrame
coarse_counts: last original initial-pose branch attempt; coarse_attempts records number of attempts
fine_counts: second filter after SearchLocalPoints, immediately before optimization
map_counts: final file joins asynchronous events by SOURCE_KEYFRAME_FRAME; event checks are not unique features; frame rows only

times_ms.orb: main RGB-D ExtractORB, excludes B2 candidate extraction
times_ms.coarse: initial tracking branches, excludes B2/B3/B4 and TrackLocalMap
times_ms.b2: Process only, excludes candidates and snapshot preparation

online: map values pending; dynamic_frontend.csv produced after thread joins; absent final file means shutdown not completed
